function.name: set_party
function.description: Record the date + party size. The return lists the open time slots - offer them to the caller and let them pick; don't choose a slot yourself.

on_date.description: Reservation date in ISO YYYY-MM-DD format (e.g. "2026-01-20").

party_size.description: Number of guests, exactly as the caller stated it - never shrink it to fit; if it's too big to seat, that's handled below.
